note: Liquidity paper alerts (Kalshi + Novig + Polymarket public books), newest first. One alert per book+market+side where >= $25000 (and >= 10% of the side's prior size) of NEW bids (within 3c of the best bid) arrived on one side since the last check (<= 60 min), at >= 3x any new money on the other side, leaving that side heavier. Main lines only (ML 15-85c, spread/total 30-70c); Kalshi moneylines combined per game. rule_met = another book also had >= $10000 on the same side, and it is the heavier side there, of the same game & market (second_book lists them; 'no_match' = game not found on the other book). price = cost to buy that side when alerted (0-1). result W/L/P/VOID from the exchange's own settlement; units_flat = 1u at price.
